$comment: Source of truth for the Spring Boot course. Lesson bodies live in lessons/<slug>.md (+ .practice.md, .quiz.json). status: planned | written. batch: the SQL batch that ships it.

course.name: Spring Boot Tutorial
course.description: A beginner-friendly backend course in simple English. Build Spring Boot 4 apps with Java 21: REST APIs, databases, security, testing and deployment.

groups.name: Getting Started
groups.description: What Spring Boot is, how to set up your tools, create and run your first project, and what every file in it does.

groups.name: Core Concepts
groups.description: The ideas every Spring app is built on: inversion of control, dependency injection, beans, scopes, lifecycle and profiles.

groups.name: Configuration
groups.description: Control your app from outside the code with properties, YAML, typed settings, logging and Actuator.

groups.name: REST API
groups.description: Build clean REST APIs step by step, from request mapping and DTOs to pagination, file transfer, HTTP clients and CORS.

groups.name: Validation and Errors
groups.description: Reject bad input early and send clear, consistent error responses from one place.

groups.name: Database
groups.description: Store and query data with Spring Data JPA: entities, repositories, relationships, transactions, auditing and migrations.

groups.name: Security
groups.description: Protect your API with Spring Security: login, password hashing, JWT, roles and method-level rules.

groups.name: Testing
groups.description: Test your code with confidence using JUnit 5, Mockito, slice tests, MockMvc and Testcontainers.

groups.name: Production
groups.description: Get your app ready for real users: caching, scheduling, async work, events, email, API docs, Kafka, Docker and deployment.

lessons.title: What is Spring Boot
lessons.description: Spring Boot is a Java framework that helps you build web apps and REST APIs fast, with smart defaults and a built-in server. Learn how it works.

lessons.title: Spring vs Spring Boot
lessons.description: Spring vs Spring Boot explained simply: what each one does, how they fit together, and the same app built both ways so you can see the difference.

lessons.title: Installing JDK and IDE for Spring Boot
lessons.description: Install Java 21 for Spring Boot on Windows, macOS or Linux, set JAVA_HOME, check your setup with a tiny program, and pick an IDE that suits you.

lessons.title: Creating a Project with Spring Initializr
lessons.description: Create your first Spring Boot project with Spring Initializr: what every form field means, adding Spring Web, running it, and generating it with curl.

lessons.title: Spring Boot Project Structure
lessons.description: Understand the Spring Boot project structure: what each folder holds, how Maven builds the JAR, where settings go, and how to organise packages.

lessons.title: Maven pom.xml Explained
lessons.description: Maven pom.xml for Spring Boot explained line by line: the starter parent, dependencies and scopes, the build plugin, and fixes for common errors.

lessons.title: Spring Boot Starters
lessons.description: Spring Boot starters explained: what one starter pulls in, the starters you will use most, the Boot 4 names, and how to swap Tomcat for Jetty.

lessons.title: Auto Configuration
lessons.description: How Spring Boot auto-configuration works: conditions, changing defaults with a property or your own bean, the debug report, and turning one off.

lessons.title: Running a Spring Boot Application
lessons.description: Run a Spring Boot app from the IDE, Maven or a JAR, pass settings like the port at start time, run code after startup and shut it down cleanly.

lessons.title: Spring Boot DevTools
lessons.description: Spring Boot DevTools explained: automatic restarts while you code, why they are fast, the development defaults it adds, and why it stays out of production.

lessons.title: Inversion of Control
lessons.description: Learn Inversion of Control in Spring Boot: how the container creates and connects your objects, with a small library example and simple diagrams.

lessons.title: Dependency Injection
lessons.description: Understand Dependency Injection in Spring Boot with a food delivery example: how the container passes helpers into your classes and why testing gets easy.

lessons.title: Spring Beans
lessons.description: Learn what a Spring bean is in Spring Boot, how @Component and @Bean create one, how beans are named, and how to look them up from the ApplicationContext.

lessons.title: Bean Scopes
lessons.description: Understand Spring Boot bean scopes: singleton, prototype and web scopes, when to use each, and how to avoid the prototype-inside-singleton trap.

lessons.title: Bean Lifecycle
lessons.description: Follow the Spring bean lifecycle from constructor to destroy, and see where @PostConstruct and @PreDestroy run, with a bike rental program and real output.

lessons.title: Component Scan
lessons.description: Learn how Component Scan finds your classes in Spring Boot, which annotations it detects, and how to fix a bean that goes missing, with clear diagrams.

lessons.title: @Configuration and @Bean
lessons.description: Learn @Configuration and @Bean in Spring Boot: build beans by hand for library classes, wire them with parameters, and see how the proxy shares one bean.

lessons.title: Constructor vs Setter vs Field Injection
lessons.description: Constructor vs setter vs field injection in Spring Boot, explained with one courier example. See why constructor injection wins and when a setter fits.

lessons.title: @Autowired and @Qualifier
lessons.description: See how @Autowired and @Qualifier work in Spring Boot, what happens when two beans match, and three ways to pick the right one, with a payment example.

lessons.title: @Primary Annotation
lessons.description: Learn the @Primary annotation in Spring Boot: mark a default bean, see how it works with @Qualifier, and avoid the two-primary error with a clinic example.

lessons.title: Spring Profiles
lessons.description: Learn Spring profiles in Spring Boot: switch beans and settings for dev, test and prod with @Profile, and run one JAR two ways to see the difference.

lessons.title: application.properties vs application.yml
lessons.description: Compare application.properties and application.yml in Spring Boot: syntax, lists, priority when both exist, and how to choose, with a bakery example.

lessons.title: @Value Annotation
lessons.description: Learn the @Value annotation in Spring Boot: read properties, set defaults, use SpEL and inject lists into constructors, with a pharmacy example.

lessons.title: @ConfigurationProperties
lessons.description: Master @ConfigurationProperties in Spring Boot: bind grouped settings to a record, use nested values, lists, Duration and validation with a clinic example.

lessons.title: Externalized Configuration
lessons.description: Understand externalized configuration in Spring Boot: priority of files, environment variables and command line arguments, tested on a cinema ticket app.

lessons.title: Logging in Spring Boot
lessons.description: Learn logging in Spring Boot with SLF4J and Logback: log levels, package settings, custom patterns and log files, using a food delivery example.

lessons.title: Spring Boot Actuator
lessons.description: Spring Boot Actuator explained: expose health, info and metrics, write a custom HealthIndicator and protect sensitive endpoints, with a hospital demo.

lessons.title: Spring MVC Architecture
lessons.description: Learn Spring MVC architecture: how the DispatcherServlet, HandlerMapping, controller, service and JSON converter handle one web request in Spring Boot.

lessons.title: @Controller vs @RestController
lessons.description: @Controller vs @RestController in Spring Boot: learn how view names, @ResponseBody, redirects and JSON responses differ, with a bakery example you can run.

lessons.title: @RequestMapping
lessons.description: Learn @RequestMapping in Spring Boot: map paths, HTTP methods, params, consumes and produces to controller methods, with a runnable gym schedule example.

lessons.title: GET POST PUT DELETE Mapping
lessons.description: Learn @GetMapping, @PostMapping, @PutMapping and @DeleteMapping in Spring Boot with a runnable tiffin order API that returns proper 201 and 204 statuses.

lessons.title: @PathVariable
lessons.description: Learn @PathVariable in Spring Boot: read ids from URL paths, use several variables, regex slots and optional values, with a runnable hospital API example.

lessons.title: @RequestParam
lessons.description: Learn @RequestParam in Spring Boot: read query parameters, set defaults, make them optional, accept lists and handle 400 errors in a shop search example.

lessons.title: @RequestBody
lessons.description: Learn @RequestBody in Spring Boot: turn a JSON request body into a Java object, handle 400 and 415 errors, and read nested data with a pharmacy example.

lessons.title: ResponseEntity
lessons.description: ResponseEntity in Spring Boot: control status codes, headers and body, return 201 with Location, 404 and 204, using a runnable cinema booking API.

lessons.title: HTTP Status Codes in Spring Boot
lessons.description: HTTP status codes in Spring Boot: learn when to send 200, 201, 204, 400, 404, 409 and 500 with @ResponseStatus and @RestControllerAdvice in a ride API.

lessons.title: DTO Pattern
lessons.description: Learn the DTO pattern in Spring Boot: separate request and response records from entities, stop data leaks and mass assignment in a hotel example.

lessons.title: Building a Complete CRUD REST API
lessons.description: Build a complete CRUD REST API in Spring Boot with controller, service, repository, DTOs and error handling, using a runnable library books example.

lessons.title: Pagination and Sorting
lessons.description: Learn pagination and sorting in Spring Boot with Pageable, Page and PagedModel. Build a paged book catalog API, then sort by any field with a live example.

lessons.title: File Upload and Download
lessons.description: File upload and download in Spring Boot made simple: use MultipartFile, save files safely, send them with Content-Disposition, and stop path traversal.

lessons.title: RestTemplate
lessons.description: RestTemplate in Spring Boot explained: call other REST APIs with getForObject and exchange, set timeouts, and handle 404 and 500 errors in a bakery app.

lessons.title: WebClient in Spring Boot
lessons.description: WebClient in Spring Boot explained: make non-blocking API calls with Mono and Flux, combine two calls, add timeouts and handle errors in a cinema example.

lessons.title: CORS in Spring Boot
lessons.description: CORS in Spring Boot explained: fix blocked browser calls with @CrossOrigin and addCorsMappings, learn how preflight works and see real response headers.

lessons.title: Bean Validation
lessons.description: Bean Validation in Spring Boot explained: use @Valid, @NotBlank, @Size and @Min on request records and return clear 400 errors in a clinic booking example.

lessons.title: Custom Validation Annotation
lessons.description: Custom validation annotation in Spring Boot: write your own @Constraint and ConstraintValidator, check pincodes and date ranges, and inject Spring beans.

lessons.title: Exception Handling in Spring Boot
lessons.description: Exception handling in Spring Boot explained: read the default error reply, then use ResponseStatusException, @ResponseStatus and @ExceptionHandler.

lessons.title: @ControllerAdvice and @ExceptionHandler
lessons.description: Learn @ControllerAdvice and @ExceptionHandler in Spring Boot: build one global handler for 404, 409, 400 and 500 replies and keep controllers clean.

lessons.title: Custom Exception Classes
lessons.description: Custom exception classes in Spring Boot: extend RuntimeException, add a status and code in a base class, wrap causes and handle them all in one place.

lessons.title: Standard API Error Response
lessons.description: Design a standard API error response in Spring Boot: one JSON shape with status, code, message and field errors, plus ProblemDetail and RFC 9457.

lessons.title: JDBC vs JPA vs Hibernate
lessons.description: JDBC vs JPA vs Hibernate explained simply for Spring Boot 4: what each one does, how they fit together, and a runnable bakery app using both.

lessons.title: Connecting Spring Boot to MySQL
lessons.description: Connecting Spring Boot to MySQL made easy: add the driver, set the JDBC URL, keep passwords safe and fix common errors, with a clinic booking example.

lessons.title: Connecting Spring Boot to PostgreSQL
lessons.description: Connecting Spring Boot to PostgreSQL step by step: driver, JDBC URL, safe password handling and real output from a library catalogue app you can run.

lessons.title: H2 In-Memory Database
lessons.description: Learn the H2 in-memory database in Spring Boot 4: automatic setup, data.sql seeding, file mode and the H2 console, with a runnable cafe menu app.

lessons.title: JPA Entity and @Entity
lessons.description: Learn how a JPA entity maps a Java class to a table in Spring Boot 4: @Entity, @Id, @Column, enums and @Transient, with a runnable bike rental app.

lessons.title: Primary Key Generation Strategies
lessons.description: Primary key generation strategies in Spring Boot JPA explained: IDENTITY, SEQUENCE, UUID, AUTO and assigned ids, with a hospital app and real output.

lessons.title: JpaRepository
lessons.description: Learn how JpaRepository works in Spring Boot 4: save, find, update, delete, sort and page with an empty interface, using a runnable tiffin meals app.

lessons.title: Derived Query Methods
lessons.description: Derived query methods in Spring Data JPA: write findBy, And, Between, OrderBy and Top method names and get queries with no SQL, using a bookshop example.

lessons.title: @Query with JPQL and Native SQL
lessons.description: Query with JPQL and native SQL in Spring Data JPA: use @Query, named parameters, projections and @Modifying safely, with a runnable gadget store app.

lessons.title: One to One Mapping
lessons.description: One-to-one mapping in Spring Boot JPA explained with a passport example: @OneToOne, owning side, mappedBy, cascade and @MapsId, with runnable code.

lessons.title: One to Many and Many to One Mapping
lessons.description: One-to-many and many-to-one mapping in Spring Boot JPA: @OneToMany, @ManyToOne, mappedBy, cascade and lazy loading, with a cinema example and real output.

lessons.title: Many to Many Mapping
lessons.description: Learn many-to-many mapping in Spring Boot with JPA: join tables, owning and inverse sides, Set vs List and a runnable book and author example.

lessons.title: Lazy vs Eager Loading
lessons.description: Understand lazy vs eager loading in Spring Boot JPA: fetch defaults, LazyInitializationException, JOIN FETCH and EntityGraph, with a runnable demo.

lessons.title: N+1 Problem
lessons.description: Spot and fix the N+1 problem in Spring Boot JPA. Count real queries with Hibernate statistics, then cure it with JOIN FETCH, EntityGraph or BatchSize.

lessons.title: @Transactional
lessons.description: Learn @Transactional in Spring Boot: commit, rollback, checked vs unchecked exceptions, rollbackFor and self-invocation, with a wallet transfer demo.

lessons.title: Auditing with @CreatedDate
lessons.description: Auditing with @CreatedDate in Spring Boot: fill created and updated times and the user automatically with @EnableJpaAuditing, plus a runnable demo.

lessons.title: Database Migration with Flyway
lessons.description: Database migration with Flyway in Spring Boot: write versioned SQL files, see how history is tracked and avoid checksum errors, with a runnable gym demo.

lessons.title: Soft Delete
lessons.description: Soft delete in Spring Boot JPA: hide rows instead of removing them with @SQLDelete and @SQLRestriction, then restore them, in a runnable shop demo.

lessons.title: Spring Security Basics
lessons.description: Spring Security basics for Spring Boot: what the starter locks by default, how SecurityFilterChain opens URLs and how HTTP Basic login works, in a demo.

lessons.title: Authentication vs Authorization
lessons.description: Authentication vs authorization in Spring Boot explained with 401 and 403 codes, roles and hasRole, plus a runnable hospital records demo for beginners.

lessons.title: Password Encoding with BCrypt
lessons.description: Password encoding with BCrypt in Spring Boot: salted hashes, encode and matches, cost factor and upgrades, with a runnable gym sign-up demo you can copy.

lessons.title: JWT Authentication
lessons.description: Learn JWT authentication in Spring Boot 4: issue a signed JWT at login, protect endpoints with it, and see how signatures stop tampered tokens.

lessons.title: Role Based Authorization
lessons.description: Role Based Authorization in Spring Boot: guard endpoints with hasRole, use a role hierarchy, and tell 401 from 403 with a movie API you can run.

lessons.title: Method Level Security
lessons.description: Method Level Security in Spring Boot: use @PreAuthorize, @PostAuthorize and @PostFilter to guard service methods with rules that read arguments.

lessons.title: Refresh Token
lessons.description: What is a refresh token in Spring Boot? Build a short-lived access JWT with a rotating refresh token, plus logout and theft detection you can run.

lessons.title: Unit Testing with JUnit 5
lessons.description: Unit testing with JUnit 5 in Spring Boot: write tests, assertions, @BeforeEach and parameterized tests, and run them with Maven, with a cinema example.

lessons.title: Mockito in Spring Boot
lessons.description: Mockito in Spring Boot made simple: mock helpers with @Mock, stub answers, verify calls and use @MockitoBean in Spring tests, with a food delivery example.

lessons.title: @SpringBootTest
lessons.description: Learn @SpringBootTest in Spring Boot: start the full context, use MockMvc or a random port, override settings and replace beans, with a cinema example.

lessons.title: @WebMvcTest and MockMvc
lessons.description: Test controllers fast with @WebMvcTest and MockMvc in Spring Boot: mock services, check status codes, JSON and validation, with a hospital appointment API.

lessons.title: @DataJpaTest
lessons.description: Use @DataJpaTest in Spring Boot to test JPA entities and repository queries on an in-memory H2 database with automatic rollback, with a library example.

lessons.title: Testcontainers Basics
lessons.description: Testcontainers basics for Spring Boot: run real PostgreSQL in Docker, connect with @ServiceConnection and avoid H2 surprises, via a pharmacy demo.

lessons.title: Caching in Spring Boot
lessons.description: Caching in Spring Boot made simple: use @Cacheable, @CachePut and @CacheEvict, see the database call vanish, and add a Caffeine expiry with runnable code.

lessons.title: Scheduling with @Scheduled
lessons.description: Learn scheduling with @Scheduled in Spring Boot: fixedRate, fixedDelay and cron jobs, one-thread traps and a runnable pharmacy example with output.

lessons.title: Async Processing with @Async
lessons.description: Async Processing with @Async in Spring Boot: run slow work in the background, return CompletableFuture, tune the thread pool and avoid the same-class trap.

lessons.title: Spring Events
lessons.description: Spring Events explained: publish an event with ApplicationEventPublisher, react with @EventListener, set @Order and see when to use async listeners.

lessons.title: Sending Email
lessons.description: Sending Email in Spring Boot with JavaMailSender: send plain and HTML mail with attachments, set up SMTP safely and test with a local mail server.

lessons.title: Swagger and OpenAPI Documentation
lessons.description: Swagger and OpenAPI documentation in Spring Boot: add springdoc, open Swagger UI, describe endpoints with annotations and hide the docs in production.

lessons.title: Spring AOP
lessons.description: Learn Spring AOP in Spring Boot: aspects, advice, pointcuts and proxies, with a bakery example that logs and audits calls without touching business code.

lessons.title: Interceptors and Filters
lessons.description: Interceptors and Filters in Spring Boot explained: how they differ, the order they run in, with a working header filter and a member-check interceptor.

lessons.title: Rate Limiting
lessons.description: Rate Limiting in Spring Boot: learn fixed window and token bucket limiters, return 429 with Retry-After, and build an OTP limiter with an interceptor.

lessons.title: Introduction to Microservices with Spring Boot
lessons.description: Introduction to Microservices with Spring Boot: monolith vs services, gateways, REST and messaging, failure handling, and when to split an app.

lessons.title: Kafka with Spring Boot
lessons.description: Kafka with Spring Boot: learn topics, partitions and consumer groups, then send and receive events with KafkaTemplate and @KafkaListener in a working app.

lessons.title: Docker for Spring Boot
lessons.description: Docker for Spring Boot: learn images, containers and Dockerfiles, build a layered image for your JAR, map ports and run your app the same on any machine.

lessons.title: Deploying Spring Boot Application
lessons.description: Deploying Spring Boot Application: build an executable JAR, use profiles and variables, keep it running with systemd, and follow a production checklist.

lessons.title: Spring Boot Interview Questions
lessons.description: Spring Boot Interview Questions with short, clear answers on starters, beans, REST, JPA, security, testing and deployment, plus tips to explain them well.

lessons.title: Spring Boot Mini Project
lessons.description: Spring Boot Mini Project: build a library lending API with JPA, validation, error handling and tests, and learn how the layers fit together end to end.
